modal.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
modal.description: Every keyboard shortcut available in the app

toggle-settings.label: Settings
toggle-settings.description: Opens and closes settings. Works anywhere in the workspace.

toggle-shortcuts.label: Keyboard shortcuts
toggle-shortcuts.description: Opens and closes this list. Works anywhere in the workspace.

toggle-sidebar.label: Sidebar
toggle-sidebar.description: Shows and hides the page sidebar. Works while you type too.

toggle-inbox.label: Inbox
toggle-inbox.description: Opens and closes the notification panel on the right.

create-new-document.label: New page
create-new-document.description: Adds a new top level page. You stay on the page you are on.

add-params-to-split-doc.label: Add a parameter list
add-params-to-split-doc.description: Use it on the left side of a split documentation block. Adds a parameter list at the bottom and puts your cursor in it.

add-code-block-to-split-doc.label: Add a code block
add-code-block-to-split-doc.description: The same key on the right side of a split documentation block. Adds a code block at the bottom and puts your cursor in its title.

add-metrics-to-split-doc.label: Add a metrics block
add-metrics-to-split-doc.description: Use it on the right side of a split documentation block. Adds a metrics block at the bottom. Your cursor does not move.
